name: @developai/grounded-opportunity-engine
description: The GROUNDED Opportunity Finder engine — search sources → find candidates → assess against an org profile → explain fit → human verifies. Shared capability consumed by Nodes (LeadFinder first); nodes are thin configurations of this engine.
comment_tests: node --test only — no framework, no devDependency. The zero-dependency rule is a locked decision (it is what lets one engine serve a standalone Node and a runtime-hosted Node identically), and it applies to the tests too.
